# ShramkoGSFPV

> Free, open-source (MIT) FPV drone simulator that runs in the browser and flies real 3D Gaussian Splatting scans from SuperSplat. Quadcopter physics with four motors, a mixer and a rate PID; Betaflight, Actual, KISS and Raceflight rate curves checked against compiled Betaflight 4.5.1; swept collision against each scan's voxel data, so the drone crashes into walls instead of flying through them; input from an EdgeTX radio over WebHID, a gamepad or touch sticks. WebGPU + PlayCanvas Engine. Author: Andrii Shramko.

Key facts:
- Runs in desktop Chrome or Edge with WebGPU; no install. Radios need WebHID (Chrome or Edge).
- Scenes: any public SuperSplat scene by link or id; scenes with voxel collision data have solid walls. The simulator's SuperSplat tab lists every public walkable scan (published with walls; 1,300+ on 2 October 2026) with superspl.at's own sorting, filters and search, a random top-rated pick and a star for favourites; the landing's "Fly a random location" opens one of the 200 best-liked at random.
- Scene switching in the page: N next, Shift+N random, F next favourite, with the radio staying connected; optional "Next scene after a crash" (off by default) loads another scene after every crash, from Andrii's picks, your favourites or the scenes you flew, in random or fixed order.
- Scene scale: [ and ] (Shift doubles a step) or the pause menu scale the whole scene around the drone from x0.25 to x100, kept per scan, the walls scaling with it: at x100 a room is flown like a city, a chair like a tower block.
- Voxel grid and walls switch: V shows the scan's collision voxels over the scan or on their own with the scan hidden (solid cubes, wireframe, height colours, or floating pieces in red), so a pilot sees where the walls really are; C switches the walls (collisions) off or on, one choice for every scene; the floating specks of a noisy scan (phantom walls) can be dropped per scan with a live preview.
- Recording and sharing: 60 fps recording (F9) and video from the flight log on Andrii's scans; share the landing or the scene being flown with a picture of the pilot's view; feedback (bug, idea, cooperation) from the simulator (B) and from every page of the site.
- Default craft: BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro class, 3S (wheelbase 93.7 mm, LAVA 1104 7200KV — manufacturer; 70.1 g / 108 g with O3 — measured by Oscar Liang).
- Crashes: impact speed decides; the craft tumbles and throws debris. Gravity: Earth, Moon, Mars, zero-g.
- Deterministic replays from recorded stick input.
- Hardware status: real EdgeTX radios and gamepads are not tested yet (a simulated EdgeTX radio is); touch sticks are tested in emulation only.
- Every published number comes from the repository's evidence/latest.json with its method and date; stick-to-photon latency with a camera has not been measured yet.

## Links
- [Website](https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/en/): the landing page (also in Spanish, Polish and Russian)
- [Simulator](https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/en/fly/): fly in the browser
- [Source code](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV): MIT-licensed repository
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents working in the repository
- [AGENT_SETUP.md](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/AGENT_SETUP.md): install, update and removal protocol for an AI agent
- [Measured facts](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/measured-facts.md): every number and how it was measured
- [Decisions](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): architecture choices and their reasons
- [Provenance](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/PROVENANCE.md): where each formula and constant comes from
- [Evidence](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/tree/main/evidence): raw measurement files
- [Screenshots](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/tree/main/docs/screenshots): real screenshots of every menu, the voxel grid and the phone layout, re-taken each release by tools/bench/src/screens.ts
- [Settings catalogue](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/settings.md): every setting of the simulator with its default, range, scope and keyboard key: 49 settings in 10 groups, 29 keyboard keys, 6 drone presets and 4 rate-curve types (generated from the settings schema at each release; in four languages at https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/en/#tune)
